issues.detail: The Hebrew 'שֵׁבֶט' means 'tribe' (or 'staff/rod' as a symbol of tribe), but the Chinese renders it as '杖' (staff/rod), which is a literal but incorrect rendering in this context. The phrase 'לַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֥בֶט הַֽמְנַשִּֽׁי' means 'to the half-tribe of Manasseh', not 'the half staff of the Manassites'. This changes the meaning from a tribal division to a physical object.
